exact_discrete_move_rule: for every feasible receiver-closed archive move m, delta_S=100*delta_d_seg+delta_sqrt(10*d_pose)+(25/37545489)*delta_B; admit only if delta_S<0, and a discrete local optimum has delta_S>=0 for every feasible neighboring move
convexified_subgradient_condition: zero belongs to the subgradient of the relaxed distortion-score term plus (25/37545489) times the subgradient of B
separable_special_case: if d(d_pose)/d(b_seg)=0, d(d_seg)/d(b_pose)=0, and d(B)/d(b_seg)=d(B)/d(b_pose)=1, then -100*d(d_seg)/d(b_seg) = -(5/sqrt(10*d_pose))*d(d_pose)/d(b_pose) = 25/37545489
non_additivity: global pair geometry is sum_i trace(K_i^2), never trace((sum_i K_i)^2); saddle-first pools A/B/C are exclusive
